lastCompletedStory.title: cam init merge_mode selector + branch-protection setup on ci-gated

nextStoryContext: applyMergeMode() in src/commands/setup-merge-mode.ts is the pure, injectable helper for the merge-mode setup step. It takes mergeMode + optional ownerRepo + SpawnFn (from branch-protection.ts) and either returns 'immediate-no-op' or delegates to configureBranchProtection(). SetupAnswers now carries mergeMode: MergeMode (exported from SetupScreen.tsx). The cam init wizard has 4 steps: mode -> issue -> merge -> description(new only) -> done. parseSetupArgs accepts --merge-mode immediate|ci-gated. runSetup writes [ship] merge_mode to project.toml and calls applyMergeMode when ci-gated. US-004 (cam config merge_mode) should mirror this pattern: extend ConfigChoices + mergeConfigChoices (src/commands/config.ts) and ConfigScreen.tsx (src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx) in the same way, reusing applyMergeMode() directly from setup-merge-mode.ts.
